messages.author: Hana Kobayashi
messages.text: Next UGC shoot is booked for Jun 25. Three creators, one per persona: 'commute gamer', 'family game night', 'competitive dice nerd'. Brief is in the doc, please add hooks you want tested by Friday.

replies.author: Priya Raman
replies.text: Hook request: 'I didn't expect a dice game to be this stressful' worked well in the June tests.

replies.author: Lucas Ferreira
replies.text: Can we get vertical 9:16 and 4:5 both? Meta feed still likes 4:5.

replies.author: Hana Kobayashi
replies.text: Yes, both. Adding to the shot list.
